activity.notes: Lacson remained the leading president of the Negros political community until 22 July 1899. The republic came under U.S. protection on 30 April 1899, so the latter part of this term should not be read as fully independent sovereignty.

sources.title: Philippines — Republic of Negros chronology
sources.citation_text: The chronology records the provisional Negros government from 5 November 1898, the Cantonal Republic from 27 November, U.S. protection from 30 April 1899, and Aniceto Lacson as president until 22 July 1899.
